citation: Lindgren O, Ahrén B Consequences on islet and incretin hormone responses to dinner by omission of lunch in healthy men. Endocrinology, Diabetes & Metabolism. 2020.
protocol: Two test days (random order): standard breakfast and standard dinner (17:00) with or without a standard lunch between; samples to 300 min after dinner
population: n=12 healthy men, mean age 22 y, BMI 22.5
note: Meal-pattern (second-meal) effect. Table is incremental AUCs; time curves are a figure. Meal composition is in the Methods.
